question: The average age of 31 students of a class is 14 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 15 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of 31 students = Average × Number of students = 14 × 31 = 434 years.

Total age of the group (including teacher) = Average × Total people = 15 × 32 = 480 years.

Age of the teacher = Total group age − Total student age = 480 − 434 = 46 years.

**∴ Answer = 46**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 31 students = 14 years

Average age of group (students + teacher) = 15 years

Total students = 31 | Total group = 32

**Formula used:**

Age of teacher = (Average age of group × Total group) − (Average age of students × Total students)

 
 Students
 Total age = 434 years
 
 Group (Students + Teacher)
 Total age = 480 years
 
• 
 Teacher = 46 years

**Calculations:**

Total age of students = 14 × 31 = 434 years

⇒ Total age of group = 15 × 32 = 480 years

⇒ Age of teacher = 480 − 434 = 46 years

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**
